items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know Gus Aikins was in this band. Gus been in all the bands.

ctx.x: Because Jobetus and Pete Briggs must have left together.
Around the same time. Carroll Dickerson had just come from Chicago, you know. And I know what'cha' callit came with Carroll... I didn't know Gus Aikins was in this band. Gus been in all the bands.
And Benny James was the banjo player.
